label: WHO prequalification: multisource finished pharmaceutical products
summary: Variations to WHO-prequalified multisource FPPs: annual notification, immediate notification, minor and major variations under TRS 981 Annex 3, with the PQT FAQ (2022) and the published timeline table, which prevails over the guideline.

trs981.title: WHO guidelines on variations to a prequalified product (WHO Technical Report Series No. 981, Annex 3)

faq22.title: WHO PQT: Frequently asked questions on variations, revision 03

tl16.title: WHO PQT: Variations approval mechanism and timeline table
tl16.date: published timelines prevail over the guideline

categories.label: Outside this pack (vaccines and biotherapeutics)
categories.rule: Vaccines and biotherapeutic products follow separate WHO PQ variation guidance, which this pack does not model.

categories.label: Not used in WHO PQ
categories.rule: WHO PQ has no such procedure; see the result.

categories.label: Separate procedure (not a variation)
categories.rule: Use the procedure named in the result.

categories.label: No variation: GMP change control
categories.rule: No variation: manage the change under GMP change control and keep the data for inspection.

categories.label: Annual notification
categories.rule: Implement, then notify WHO within 12 months (grouped annual notifications are recommended). Keep the data available.

categories.label: Immediate notification
categories.rule: Implement and notify immediately; the change is accepted unless WHO objects within the review period.

categories.label: Minor variation
categories.rule: Submit, then implement if WHO has not started correspondence within 60 days of acknowledging receipt.

categories.label: Major variation
categories.rule: Implement only after WHO issues a letter of acceptance.

categories.label: New application (Appendix 1 changes)
categories.rule: Changes listed in Appendix 1 of the guideline (such as a new strength, dosage form or route) need a new application.

WHO-30a:1.text: The product is an immediate-release oral form or a non-sterile liquid.

WHO-30a:2.text: Changes to the method are only those the new size needs, with similar equipment.

WHO-30a:3.text: Validation is done or a validation protocol and commitment are in place.

WHO-30a:4.text: Release and shelf-life specifications are unchanged.

WHO-31a:1.text: The product is not sterile and not modified release.

WHO-31a:2.text: The manufacturing principle is unchanged and specifications are unchanged.

WHO-31a:3.text: The change does not come from stability problems or manufacturing failures.

WHO-8e:1.text: Same route of synthesis, specifications and impurity profile.

WHO-8e:2.text: The site has acceptable GMP status (inspected by WHO or a stringent authority, or evidence acceptable to PQT).

WHO-8e:3.text: Stability and validation commitments are given.

WHO-5b:1.text: A valid Ph. Eur. CEP covers the new manufacturer.

WHO-5b:2.text: The FPP manufacturer's specification for the API covers all CEP tests plus any extra tests needed.

WHO-5b:3.text: No change to the API particle size or polymorph requirements.

multipleChanges.rule: Changes can be grouped only if consequential, if they affect several FPPs of one applicant, or if all are annual notifications. A group is filed in one form and takes the highest category.

AN.label: Notify within 12 months of implementation; WHO acknowledges within 45 days

IN.label: Acknowledgement within 7 days; accepted unless WHO objects within 45 days of acknowledgement (the 2013 guideline said 30)

VMIN.label: Implement if WHO has not started correspondence within 60 days of acknowledgement

VMAJ.label: Initial review within 90 days of acknowledgement; implement after the acceptance letter

NEWAPP.label: Assessed as a new application; timing not modelled

variation.label: Variation application form with the summary of changes and implementation dates
Quality information summary, revised (tracked and clean), if affected

annual.label: Variation application form listing the annual notifications and their dates

pi.label: Product information (SmPC, patient leaflet, labels), tracked and clean
